name.en-US: St. Maria Francesca of Jesus Rubatto
name.pt-BR: Santa Maria Francisca de Jesus Rubatto

prayerExcerpt.en-US: "We are servants of the poor, and we must take up any service for them."
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: "Somos servas dos pobres e devemos assumir por eles qualquer serviço."

meta.face: A Piedmontese of about fifty-five with a fair complexion and a BROAD, FULL face — rounded cheeks and a soft fullness under the chin, a smooth forehead under the wimple, THICK, dark, straight brows, LARGE, PALE grey eyes set wide, open and calm, a straight nose BROAD at the bridge, a SMALL, full-lipped mouth closed firmly, a rounded chin; the gaze level, strong and kindly. Not the flat, rectangular face with small deep-set eyes and thin mouth of marie_leonie_paradis, nor the long, narrow maria_santocanale.
meta.basis: Her photographs (Wikimedia Commons, before 1904; the congregation's coloured photograph on scmrubatto.org; the Dicastery's portrait drawn from them): a broad, full face with thick dark brows, large pale eyes, a broad-bridged straight nose and a small full mouth, in a dark-brown habit, black veil and broad white guimpe. Montevideo is where she led her sisters' mission and died.
meta.excerpt: Her words to her sisters, «Servae sumus pauperum iisque quodcumque ministerium obire debemus», as the decree quoted on the Dicastery's page gives them in Latin; our rendering (she died in 1904)
